name: Rainbow Grocery
description: Rainbow Grocery is a worker-owned cooperative grocery store in San Francisco's Mission District offering natural, organic, and vegetarian foods, with a 10% discount for seniors and volume discounts.
fullDescription: Rainbow Grocery is a worker-owned cooperative grocery store in San Francisco's Mission District offering natural, organic, and vegetarian foods, with a 10% discount for seniors and volume discounts.
whatTheyOffer:
- 10% off everything for seniors 60+ with ID
- Volume discounts (10% off $100+, 15% off $200+, 20% off $400+ per department) and case discounts
- 5 cents off for each reused container in Bulk, Bakery, or Produce
- Natural, organic, local, and vegetarian foods
- Bulk foods to save money
- Planned 10% Community Discount pilot for CalFresh/EBT, WIC, SSI, CalWORKs, and other program participants (not yet launched; ask the store)
howToGetIt: Tell the cashier at the start of your transaction that you plan to use a discount and show ID for the senior discount. Discounts are in-store only and not available through delivery services. Open 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily except holidays.
keywords: Rainbow Grocery, senior discount, community discount, EBT, organic food, natural food, cooperative, bulk food, vegetarian, San Francisco
